title: Budgie Chirping 2
author: squashy555
changes: Pet budgerigar (Melopsittacus undulatus), a blue budgie called Marty, chirping and warbling. Trimmed to 36.02–38.29 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
